Fed & Policy Watch
  • Today's verified data cluster is 8:30 AM ET Business Leaders Survey and Imports and Exports, followed by G.17 at 9:15 AM and the New York Fed Staff Nowcast at 12:45 PM. The New York Fed calendar supplies the dates and ET times for BLS-related entries; no BLS page was accessed.
  • The Board calendar lists the next FOMC meeting for October 27-28, outside this October 16-22 week-ahead window. BEA lists third-quarter 2026 GDP (advance estimate) for October 29 at 8:30 AM ET. The New York Fed October calendar also lists Personal Income and the PCE Deflator on October 29 at 8:30 AM, without a period label; this is beyond the displayed week.
  • TreasuryDirect now posts exact competitive cutoff times for the October 19-22 auctions shown above; no date-only auction rows are used. H.4.1 is scheduled October 22 at 4:30 PM ET, not today.
  • Energy check: EIA's published petroleum schedule confirms the Columbus Day-adjusted October 15 report at noon, already elapsed at this cutoff. No date-specific EIA petroleum or natural-gas report entry for October 16-22 was verified; no release was inferred from weekly cadence.
Omissions and Watch
  • Date/event conflict check: the New York Fed calendar places CPI on October 14 and PPI, Initial Claims, and Census Advance Retail Sales on October 15; all are at or before the October 16 00:30:35 ET cutoff and are excluded. Employment Situation was dated October 2. No elapsed release appears in either calendar table.
  • Checked primary calendars: New York Fed October Economic Indicators Calendar; Federal Reserve Board October calendar and H.4.1; Census 2026 calendar; BEA schedule; Chicago Fed data-release calendar and NFCI file; Philadelphia Fed survey information; TreasuryDirect upcoming auctions; EIA petroleum and natural-gas schedules; and NAR release schedule. NAR Pending Home Sales date/time is sourced to the New York Fed October calendar. Selected Board statistical releases only; routine daily CP and H.15 rows are omitted.
  • NAR's schedule page did not return a date-specific future row in the retrieved text. The NAR Pending Home Sales event listed for October 20 is independently date/time verified on the New York Fed October calendar. Philadelphia Fed MBOS did not show an October release on its own page; the October 20 Non-Manufacturing Survey timing comes from the New York Fed calendar and is distinct from MBOS.
  • EIA pages were reachable, but the petroleum schedule's specific dated entries after October 15 were not present, and no date-specific natural-gas entry was verified for October 16-22. Those releases are omitted rather than projected from customary cadence. This is not a claim that no report will publish.
  • Checked sources show an October 29 New York Fed Personal Income/PCE Deflator calendar entry with no period; BEA separately schedules Personal Income and Outlays for October 2026 on December 2. They are not represented as the same period. October 29 GDP and October 27-28 FOMC are outside this week's calendar.
  • No verified unscheduled geopolitical or policy watch item from this run. Energy events without a verified future date/time and unlisted market-structure events are not invented. No exchange product-hours verification was performed; confirm active contract, hours, liquidity and event updates before execution.
  • Market quotes are single-source Yahoo observations; SOFR, NFCI and yields are dated official publications, not live values. Source observation dates and retrieval times are shown above.
Trading Strategy Note | ES Futures
BASE CASE
Use the 12:20 AM ET generic ES=F quote as overnight context only. MOVE at 102.49 signals moderate rate uncertainty; the latest official 10Y close is 5.10%. Today's 8:30 AM data pair and 9:15 AM G.17 are checkpoints for price discovery, not a directional forecast. Scenario framework only, not a trade signal.
INVALIDATION
Reassess if ES sustains a range break without confirmation from live Treasury yields, volatility and market depth, or if the selected contract's hours differ. No unsupported levels or targets are supplied; reconfirm live quotes and event updates before execution.
